events.title: Multitarget Kill
events.summary: Some situations demand more than a single shot. Multitarget Kill is a special ability unlocked by experienced Assault operatives, allowing them to eliminate two enemy targets during a single turn. Timing is everything. Used at the right moment, Multitarget Kill can quickly remove key threats, disrupt enemy positions, and create an opening for the rest of your squad. events.title: Group Movement
events.summary: A coordinated squad is an effective squad. Group Movement makes commanding your squad more intuitive and efficient, keeping your elite operatives together and focused on the mission. While group movement is common in real-time strategy games, it remains rare in turn-based tactical strategy games. In Ghost Justice, it helps maintain the pace of every operation while preserving the deliberate tactical decision-making that defines the genre. events.summary: Planning Mode gives you complete control while your squad remains undetected. Assign multiple actions to your operatives, carefully coordinate their movements, and prepare the entire operation exactly the way you want it. Once everything is in place, execute the plan with a single command and watch your coordinated ambush unfold. events.title: Ghost Justice Announced
events.summary: Ghost Justice is a turn-based tactical strategy game set in a brutal modern narco conflict, where governments have lost control and ruthless cartels dominate entire regions. Inspired by real-world anti-cartel operations, Ghost Justice emphasises careful planning, coordinated teamwork, and meaningful tactical decisions rather than fast-paced action.
